retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast, backlit industrial tunnel composition featuring silhouetted figures walking toward the viewer from a central light source.
excludeWhen: soft or diffuse lighting is needed without high contrast

recipe.visualDefinition: A deep perspective shot inside a ribbed concrete or metal pipe where concentric rings lead to a blinding white light at the center. In the foreground, a group of figures is rendered as dark silhouettes, casting long shadows toward the viewer on a reflective, wet floor.
coreVisualRelationships: Concentric rings framing a central light source
Silhouetted figures contrasting against a bright background
Long shadows extending from the figures toward the bottom edge
Industrial texture of the tunnel walls versus the smooth glow of the light

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: A group of four figures positioned in the lower-middle third, scaled to appear distant but prominent.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central white circular light at the vanishing point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye is drawn from the outer edges of the tunnel inward toward the light, then down to the silhouetted figures and their shadows.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The dark, textured walls of the tunnel provide heavy framing negative space.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep slate blue and charcoal gray in the shadows and tunnel walls.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Pure white for the central light source.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Subtle cyan and teal highlights in the mid-tones of the concrete.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation with extreme value contrast between the light source and the silhouettes.
paletteRestrictions: Avoid warm tones like red or orange
Maintain a monochromatic or near-monochromatic cool palette

composition.relationshipToImage: floating above the dark tunnel ceiling

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single font family used with extreme tracking to emphasize the width of the composition.

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the wide, industrial geometric feel.
Provides a clean, modern geometric look with wide proportions.
Matches the technical, wide-set aesthetic of the era.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast industrial tunnel in one-point perspective. The walls should have concentric circular ribs. A bright white light is at the center vanishing point. Four silhouetted figures in dark clothing walk toward the viewer on a wet, reflective floor, casting long shadows. Color grade is deep blue and charcoal.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add uppercase geometric sans-serif text at the top, centered horizontally. Use an extended width font with extremely wide tracking so the text spans nearly the entire width of the image.

verificationChecks: Is the perspective a perfect one-point vanishing point?
Are the figures completely silhouetted against the light?
Is the color palette restricted to cool blues and grays?
Is the text tracking wide enough to feel airy and cinematic?

adjustableVariables: Number of figures in the silhouette
Intensity of the blue color grade
Texture of the tunnel walls (smooth vs. ribbed)
Amount of water/reflection on the floor
mustRedesign: Avoid using specific band names or album titles
Do not replicate the exact faces of the individuals

mustAchieve: Strong sense of depth through concentric circles
Sharp contrast between light and dark
avoid: Cluttered or centered text that blocks the light source

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the light source is pure white and centered.
Check that shadows align with the central light source.
Verify text is perfectly horizontal and centered at the top.
Confirm the industrial texture is visible in the tunnel walls.
recipe.reuseFormula: Industrial Tunnel + Concentric Framing + Backlit Silhouette + Wide Geometric Typography
